subject: Mathematics
title: Permutations and Combinations
summary: Counting fundamental principle se shuru hoti hai: agar ek kaam m tareekon se aur doosra n tareekon se ho sakta hai, to dono saath m × n tareekon se (aur koi ek m + n tareekon se).
Permutation arrangements ginte hain (order maayne rakhta hai): ⁿPᵣ = n!/(n − r)!. Combination selections ginte hain (order maayne nahi rakhta): ⁿCᵣ = n!/(r!(n − r)!).
Special cases: identical objects, circular arrangements, restrictions (saath / kabhi saath nahi), identical objects ka distribution (stars and bars) aur derangements.

formulas.name: Fundamental principle
formulas.when: Counting problem ko stages mein todna.

formulas.name: Permutations
formulas.formula: ⁿPᵣ = n!/(n − r)!;  with repetition allowed: nʳ

formulas.name: Combinations
formulas.formula: ⁿCᵣ = n!/(r!(n − r)!);  ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₙ₋ᵣ;  ⁿCᵣ + ⁿCᵣ₋₁ = ⁿ⁺¹Cᵣ
formulas.mistake: Agar ⁿCₓ = ⁿCᵧ to x = y ya x + y = n — doosra case mat bhoolna.

formulas.name: Identical objects
formulas.formula: n!/(p! q! r! …) for p alike of one kind, q of another, …

formulas.name: Together / never together
formulas.formula: k particular objects together: treat as one block → (n − k + 1)! × k!;  never together = total − together

formulas.name: Gap method
formulas.formula: to keep k objects apart, arrange the others first, then choose gaps: (n − k)! × ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁺¹Pₖ

formulas.name: Distributing identical objects
formulas.formula: n identical objects into r groups: ⁿ⁺ʳ⁻¹Cᵣ₋₁ (empty allowed);  ⁿ⁻¹Cᵣ₋₁ (each group ≥ 1)
formulas.when: Stars and bars / x₁ + … + xᵣ = n ke non-negative integer solutions.

formulas.name: Selections from identical objects
formulas.formula: from p alike, q alike, r alike: (p + 1)(q + 1)(r + 1) − 1 non-empty selections;  from n distinct: 2ⁿ − 1

formulas.name: Geometry counting
formulas.formula: lines through n points (no 3 collinear) = ⁿC₂;  triangles = ⁿC₃;  diagonals of n-gon = ⁿC₂ − n;  with m collinear: subtract ᵐC₂ − 1 lines, ᵐC₃ triangles

formulas.name: Number of divisors
formulas.formula: if N = p^a q^b r^c then divisors = (a + 1)(b + 1)(c + 1);  sum of divisors = Π (p^{a+1} − 1)/(p − 1)

examples.title: Round table
examples.problem: 6 log round table par kitne tareekon se baith sakte hain? Aur necklace par 6 beads?

examples.title: Committee
examples.problem: 5 mein se 3 men aur 4 mein se 2 women chuno.

examples.title: 4 letters ke derangements
examples.problem: 4 letters ko 4 addressed envelopes mein kitne tareekon se daal sakte hain ki koi bhi sahi envelope mein na jaaye?

examples.title: 4-digit numbers
examples.problem: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 se bina repetition kitne 4-digit numbers ban sakte hain?
examples.solution: Pehla digit: 5 choices (0 nahi); baaki 3 jagah 5 digits se: ⁵P₃ = 60. Total = 5 × 60 = 300.

examples.title: Identical balls
examples.problem: 10 identical balls ko 3 alag boxes mein kitne tareekon se daal sakte hain (khaali box allowed)?

examples.title: Diagonals
examples.problem: Decagon mein kitne diagonals hote hain?

topics.title: Factorial basics
topics.explain: n! = n(n − 1)…1; 0! = 1. ⁿPᵣ = r! × ⁿCᵣ. n! mein prime p ka exponent [n/p] + [n/p²] + [n/p³] + … hai (jaise 100! mein trailing zeros 24).

topics.title: Words with restrictions
topics.explain: Vowels saath: vowels ko ek block maano. Vowels odd places par: pehle vowels ki jagah chuno. Dictionary (rank) problems: har chhote letter se shuru hone wale words baari-baari gino.

topics.title: Grouping and division
topics.explain: m + n distinct objects ko m aur n ke do groups mein baantna: (m + n)!/(m! n!). Barabar size ke (unlabelled) groups mein, barabar groups ki sankhya ke factorial se bhi divide karo.

topics.title: Circular with restrictions
topics.explain: Round table par do khaas log saath: (n − 2)! × 2!. Men aur women baari-baari (n-n): (n − 1)! × n!.

topics.title: Integer solutions
topics.explain: x + y + z = 10 ke positive integral solutions ⁹C₂ = 36; non-negative solutions ¹²C₂ = 66. Upper limits ke liye inclusion–exclusion ya polynomial expansions ke coefficients use karo.

topics.title: When order matters
topics.explain: Poocho 'kya do chune items ko swap karne se naya outcome milta hai?' — haan to permutation; nahi to combination. Zyadatar galtiyan selection ko arrangement ki tarah ginne se hoti hain.

ratta: ⁿPᵣ = n!/(n − r)!;  ⁿCᵣ = n!/(r!(n − r)!).
